adoptions.obligation: goals never assign Ledger, ResumeLog or LinkedinCache fields; only their verbs change them
a posting key is recorded once; Ledger.record refuses a key it already holds, so a posting is notified once
existing ledger rows are never rewritten or removed; save() only appends rows recorded since load
scrape selection is pure: select_listings imports nothing that does I/O; enrichment happens after it
linkedin_cache.json holds only hits: lowercased company keys mapped to linkedin.com/company/<slug>; a miss is never cached
a board enters the registry only after its public API answered 200, once per (ats, tenant); a posting is marked emitted at most once
every request to an ATS API carries exactly the fixed project headers: no name, email, handle or contact
the ATS poller hands on at most 8 postings per run and 40 per UTC day, only lane-matched, US, fresh postings whose key is not in the ledger or already emitted
